2021_221_aug_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for August 2021, presented to the Board of Education at its October 19, 2021 meeting, itemizes every district PCARD transaction posted through journal entry "AUG PCARD EXP," listing each merchant, transaction date, budget unit, account code, charge amount and credit. The report closes with a subtotal of $262,565.97 in charges against $1,337.78 in credits, yielding total expenses of $261,228.19. The single largest charge is $34,980.00 to ZOOM.US on 7/28/2021, coded to budget unit 101790225000000, account 3450.
